issues.title: Clickable Force Field
issues.body:
Currently, the text boxes for Forces in the admin page react as the mouse hovers over them by showing the garbage bin. This is a great feature since it allows the user to delete a Force without having to click on it. However, the animation makes the user think that the entire field is clickable. Unfortunately, the user can only open the force when they click on the actual force title. 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/160403297-b90afd39-fb40-40d5-90fb-3f2033e85de7.mp4

It would be more intuitive for the force to open up wherever the user clicks inside the text box.
